hero.headline: One universe.
hero.body: The Nexus is a massive interconnected gaming universe built on Solana. Three worlds. Sixteen zones. One unified economy powered by USGC. Every coin you hold is a key. Every action earns you something real.

worlds.headline: The interconnected universe
worlds.body: Each world is a distinct game experience — but they share the same economy, the same wallet, and the same player identity. Assets earned in one world carry weight in all others.

editions.headline: 16 edition zones — all live
editions.body: Every edition is a fully playable zone with its own seasonal coins, quests, and War Room battle history. 1,500+ coins across the entire map.

specialCoins.headline: Special coin types
specialCoins.body: Beyond seasonal coins, the Nexus has five categories of special assets. Each one is earned — never bought directly — and carries real utility across all zones.

pillars.headline: Five ways to play
pillars.body: Every pillar is live and playable right now. Mix them or master one — your Nexus, your rules.

interop.headline: Cross-zone interoperability
interop.body: Assets earned in one zone carry real weight in others. The Nexus is one economy — not a collection of isolated games.

community.headline: Community hubs
community.body: The social layer of the Nexus. Connect with other players, form alliances, and coordinate across zones.

identity.headline: Your identity. Your assets. Your Nexus.
identity.body: Every coin, every Key, every Artifact is stored in your Tienko Wallet — a Solana-native wallet that travels with you across all three worlds. Your collection tier, RPG character, War Room rank, and journey stage are all tied to one persistent identity.
